newsitem.title: USA: Blackstone acquires assets of Balfour Holdings.
newsitem.headline: Blackstone acquires assets of Balfour Holdings.

text.p: Blackstone Real Estate Advisors LP, a privately held merchant banking firm, said on Thursday it had acquired Balfour Holdings Inc, a real estate investment and development firm, in a transaction valued at approximately $60 million.
Blackstone Real Estate Partners II, a $1 billion private real estate investment fund, funded the deal, which included the assumption of existing project debt, Blackstone said.
Balfour owns and manages a portfolio of residential and commercial land development projects in eight states, Blackstone said.
